title: Improving Irrigation Regimes and Plant Spacing to Maximize Rice Grain Yield and Water Productivity
authors: Hasnaa A. Ghazy; B. B. Mikhael; I. S. El-Refaee
location_name: Experimental Farm, Sakha Research Station, Kafr El-Sheikh, Egypt
limitations: Small experimental station plots with three replications; results are not representative farmer-field observations.
The paper reports treatment water productivity but the extracted tables do not provide absolute seasonal applied-water volumes by treatment.
Do not convert these results directly into pump run-time recommendations without local pump discharge and field calibration.
Yield results are influenced by the study's cultivar, clayey soil, seedling age, spacing, fertilizer package, and trial management.
